description: The lesson is kept, the credential is not. Every variant names the variable and never its value.

add.body: `npm run deploy:staging` has to run under the staging AWS profile; with ambient personal credentials in the shell it fails against the wrong account, which looks like a permissions bug in the script.
Deploys to staging require the staging AWS profile to be selected explicitly; the deploy script does not pin it and silently inherits whatever credentials the shell already has.
Told never to write a credential value into a comment, a doc or a commit; keys are rotated and a stale copy in the repo sends the next person debugging the wrong thing.
Staging deploys must select the staging AWS profile; without it the script picks up ambient personal credentials and fails against the wrong account.
